description: Create a Free project in front of an existing HTTPS API. No signup or payment required. For a credential-free demo use https://sandbox.gate.odilelabs.com with GET /customers/:cid/tickets/:id (customer A holds tickets 1-3, B holds 4-5: try GET /customers/A/tickets/1). Returns project_id, admin_key (shown once) and the gateway base URL apps call instead of the API. A real API and its credentials need owner authorization.

header_name.description: Optional: the secret header your API expects, e.g. Authorization or apikey

header_value.description: Optional: its value. Stored encrypted; apps never see it.

name.description: A name for the project, e.g. "Shop API"

upstream.description: The API base URL, https only, e.g. https://api.example.com/v1

name: gate_create_project
title: Create a Gate project
